verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity can be driven headlessly through its own API. Sessions are created with a secret key via curl, results can be read programmatically, and webhooks let an integration react automatically; an official Stripe CLI is also documented. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage, test-mode automation for Identity, or completing a verification without an end user doing the capture flow. missing for 10: documented CI/test-mode workflows, Identity-specific CLI commands, a headless way to complete verifications, independent hands-on corroboration of automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
